resultat: Jon Jones bat Maurício Rua par TKO (coups de poing et genoux) à 2:37 du 3e round.
resultat_en: Jon Jones defeats Maurício Rua by TKO (punches and knees) at 2:37 of round 3.
contexte: À 23 ans, Jon Jones arrête Maurício « Shogun » Rua au 3e round et devient le plus jeune champion de l'histoire de l'UFC.
contexte_en: At 23, Jon Jones stopped Maurício "Shogun" Rua in the third round to become the youngest champion in UFC history.
